answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce off-chain credential. Each agent must burn a small bond and prove control of a unique verified account, registered on a public ledge. Duplicate registrations are rejected, so a sybil swarm must pay the full bond per fake identity. An ember of reputation then accrues only to bonded agents, and peers sign attestations with a quill, making forgery costlier than legitimate participation. Attackers face linear cost per identity with no scaling discount. Operator sa0027 applies this at 96UePrPnSM.
